title: Warcraftisgood's Awesome Weapons
description: Adds 75+ unique and detailed weapons inspired by popular video games with awesome abilities.
body:
Adds 75+ weapons inspired from a variety of different video games including but not limited to World of Warcraft, League of Legends, Star Wars, etc. This mod was inspired by Popularmmos's mini games that could make use of these weapons such as Challenge Games, Hunger games, etc, and weapons are designed in a more crazy/explosive style reminiscent to the 2015 mod era.

Weapons are designed to be large and cool to look at when held, and most weapons have detailed abilities that are designed to live out character fantasies of the respective weapons they were inspired by from other video games.

Mod is highly configurable. (attack damage/drop rates/ability cooldown/weapon placement/rarities) Although the mod is balanced for regular survival, it is more intended to be used for larger mod packs or multiplayer minigames (Such as PVE in Challenge games, or PVP in Hunger Games). Weapons are separated by rarities, with common weapons usually having no abilities and higher rarity weapons having more awesome abilities. Most weapons of rare or higher quality have built in configurable scaling, meaning their abilities will deal higher dmg based on their attack damage (most commonly scaled through sharpness).

Weapons can be acquired randomly in survival from either crafting expensive caches or farming caches from mobs. All mobs with by default 20 or more base hp will have a chance to drop weapon caches, with higher hp mobs having higher drop rates. Infinite scaling through Wakening Essence, which can be crafted or drop from high hp boss mobs, allows players to scale their weapons by infinitely increasing sharpness for even the craziest mod packs with insane power levels through natural gameplay. Certain weapons are better suited for Player Verses Player combat and will also drop from a special cache that can drop from killing other players.
